basics.description: Your logo, business name, tagline, and a short description.

businessType.title: Business Type
businessType.description: Select the type that best describes your business.

categories.title: Category & Subcategory
categories.description: Select one or more categories that best fit your business. Subcategories will be filtered based on your category selection.

website.title: Website
website.description: Provide your business contact information. This will help customers reach you easily.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Add one or more phone numbers for your business. Customers can use these numbers to contact you directly. You can specify a label for each number (e.g., "Main Line", "Customer Support") to indicate its purpose.

email.title: Email
email.description: Add one or more email addresses for your business. Customers can use these emails to contact you directly. You can specify a label for each email (e.g., "General Inquiries", "Support") to indicate its purpose.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Select the amenities and features your business offers.

address.title: Business Address
address.description: Start typing your address in the search box. Select the correct address from the dropdown, and the rest of the fields will auto-fill with the correct information. You can make adjustments to any field if needed.

hours.title: Business Opening Hours
hours.description: Set your business opening hours for each day of the week. You can specify multiple time ranges for each day (e.g., 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM) to accommodate breaks or split shifts. This information will help customers know when your business is open.

closures.title: Holidays & special hours
closures.description: Mark the days your business is closed — or open with special hours — like holidays, a one-off closure, or a half-day. Pick date(s) on the calendar, name them, and mark any that repeat every year.

socials.title: Social Media Links
socials.description: Add links to your social media profiles. This will help customers find and follow you on social media.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Upload a banner image that represents your business. This will be displayed prominently on your listing page. You can also choose a primary color that matches your brand, which will be used for accents and highlights on your listing.

images.title: Images
images.description: Upload additional images to showcase your business. These images will appear in a gallery on your listing page, allowing you to highlight your products, services, or ambiance. We recommend using high-quality images with a 16:9 aspect ratio for the best display results.
